method.primary: Three alternating fresh-process rounds on CPU8; one fixed warmup per measured boundary; prepared reduction and independent continuous fresh input/rule construction through the same requested materialization. Neither sums of phase medians nor process/import startup.
method.order: Default graph order for both releases. Historical original/early names identify FORM schedules; native default ignores their explicit fixture schedules.
method.FORM: FORM5.0.0 calibrated independent-expression batch body CPU excluding startup/input declarations; all trials retained.
method.diagnostics: Three separate warmed calls; exact output compared to the primary checked result. Phase clocks are not additive estimates of end-to-end medians.
method.host: Shared machine with fixed CPU affinity; not an exclusive-host measurement and no confidence interval from3samples.

complete_algebra.scope: Fresh make_case plus input/rule construction and the same reduction/requested materialization; excludes interpreter/import startup, checks, diagnostics, output and disposal. Executed after the prepared-input sample; this is one continuous clock, not summed medians.

from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, statistics, sys, time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {8})
frontend = Path("/tmp/symbolica-community-color-regression/examples/hep")
sys.path.insert(0, str(frontend))
from symbolica import E, core
from tensor_benchmark_cases import make_case
from tensor_benchmark_factorized import prepare, reduce

sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source_paths = [
    frontend / name
    for name in [
        "fermion_ladder.py",
        "tensor_benchmark_cases.py",
        "tensor_benchmark_factorized.py",
    ]
]
sources = {str(p): sha(p) for p in source_paths}
case = make_case(args.case)
route = "factorized" if args.case.startswith(("historical-", "gluon-")) else "typed"
expected_path = (
    Path("/tmp/feynkit-full-algebra-timings/graph/report")
    / f"current-{args.case}-{route}-check.expression"
)
expected = E(expected_path.read_text())
if route == "factorized":
    prepared = prepare(case)

    def call():
        phases = {}
        assert reduce(case, prepared, phases, order_policy="graph") == expected
        return phases
else:

    def call():
        return case.phases(expected)


call()
rows = [call() for _ in range(3)]
assert all(sha(p) == digest for p, digest in sources.items())
result = {
    "case": args.case,
    "core_sha256": sha(core.__file__),
    "sources": sources,
    "expected_expression_sha256": sha(expected_path),
    "rounds": rows,
    "fixed_warmups": 1,
    "scope": "Separate diagnostic calls on CPU8, prepared input; phase medians are not summed or substituted for continuous main clocks. Exact equality to independently checked primary output after each call.",
}
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"case": args.case, "output": str(args.output)}), flush=True)
